title: Thư cuối M2 (mô phỏng, mơ màng)
about: The user asked for a modelled piano instead of a recorded one ("tiếng mô phỏng thay vì tiếng thu âm thật"): dark/piano_model.py makes every note from the physics of its strings (no recording), fitted to the user's choice (H3: its partials note by note, its loudness key by key) and the references' tune. M2: dreamier, as the references sound to a machine ear (ambient): strings further apart, the other strings ringing along, a softer onset and a longer hall.
